runners_data.name: Pink Venom

runners_data.name: Westminster Waltz

races.name: BOYLE Sports Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Bella Isabella
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with Group 3 form who should track the leader perfectly and has proven 7f ability on similar going
runners_data.comment: Career-best when third in a C&D Group 3 event last season, well beaten on seasonal debut
runners_data.spotlight: Cork maiden winner (7f, good) last season went on to take third of eight in a  Group 3 next time (7f, good); finished around 2l behind today's rival Mallavelly (third) when seventh of 20 in a 1m premier handicap here on her final start last term; well beaten on seasonal debut at Naas

runners_data.name: Mehman
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 26-day break with inconsistent turf form but solid recent AW efforts suggesting fitness
runners_data.comment: Four AW wins, 1-22 record on turf is a concern but recent efforts have been encouraging
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time AW winner, sole turf success came in 5f handicap at Naas in May 2024; solid effort when over 1m at Bellewstown in April and backed that up with a close third over 6f at Naas last month; 1-22 record on turf is a concern but those recent efforts have been encouraging

runners_data.name: Flaming Rib
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from out-of-form stable returning after 169-day absence with regressive recent form
runners_data.comment: Seven wins and second in 2022 Commonwealth Cup, regressive and remains risky
runners_data.spotlight: Seven wins in Britain; runner-up for Hugo Palmer in 2022 Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot; regressive since 2023; improved from a moderate stable debut last September when close fourth in a 7f rated at Dundalk in November; last of ten at the same venue in December; rated 113 at his peak, now down to 79 but remains risky.

runners_data.name: Mallavelly
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong course record and progressive handicap form but needs pace to aim at
runners_data.comment: Progressive in handicaps last year, sights lowered again after a Group 3 bid on return
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive in handicaps last year; went up an aggregate 11lb for wins here and Tipperary and ended season with a fine third in a premier handicap at this venue (Bella Isabella, seventh); sights lowered again after a 1m Group 3 bid here on return; definite chance.

runners_data.name: Dark Viper
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with excellent course record over longer trips but may find 7f too sharp
runners_data.comment: Has recorded his only two wins over 1m at this venue, second ten times, below best lately
runners_data.spotlight: Has recorded his only two wins over 1m at this venue; ground was heavy when he scored off this mark last October, his 2024 win was on good going; his record of finishing second ten times strikes a note of caution; below best in three 2026 appearances.

runners_data.name: Eddie G
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 380-day layoff with poor turf record and significant fitness concerns
runners_data.comment: Two AW wins, 0-11 on turf, ran only twice last season, good effort on the first occasion
runners_data.spotlight: Two AW wins, 0-11 on turf; ran only twice last season; denied a clear run when third of 14 on his seasonal reappearance in first-time tongue time at Roscommon; failed to build on that Cork eight days later and absent since.

runners_data.name: Playin Cool
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose best form comes over longer trips, making 7f potentially inadequate
runners_data.comment: Course maiden winner over 1m1f last October, yet to make an impact in handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Ended last season with a 1m1f course maiden win on heavy ground; yet to make an impact in handicaps; trip might be inadequate.

runners_data.name: Great Mover
runners_data.note: Prominent type who has failed to recapture best form in four runs this season
runners_data.comment: Only one win from 20 starts, has failed to retrieve her best form in four races this term
runners_data.spotlight: Only win from 20 starts came on heavy ground at Gowran last September; has failed to retrieve her best form in four outings this term, though she was aimed high in the Irish Lincoln and was not beaten far in sixth over 1m at Limerick on her penultimate start; down in trip again after a 1m2f run here last time, eased when beaten.

runners_data.name: Loingseoir
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse making rare Leopardstown visit with moderate recent form
runners_data.comment: Durable veteran, 7-74, placed 13 times, two mid-division runs this season, retains ability
runners_data.spotlight: Durable veteran, 7-74, placed 13 times; recorded his most recent win last autumn; best form at the Curragh and Fairyhouse; makes a rare visit to Leopardstown, placed on both starts here; two mid-division runs this season; retains ability

runners_data.name: Thru And Thru
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader returning after 50-day break with solid handicap debut but form tail-off concerns
runners_data.comment: Maiden with fair placed form, something seemingly amiss when favourite here in April
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly-raced filly; second twice in maidens and made a bright start in handicaps when third of 12 over 7f at Naas in March; something seemingly amiss when favourite here in April, though vet's report revealed nothing; may bounce back now.

runners_data.name: Send Harry
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with AW win over this trip but inconsistent turf form this season
runners_data.comment: Dependable on turf last summer, Dundalk winner, fair chance on last year's form
runners_data.spotlight: Dependable on turf last summer, when his form included two Curragh placings over 6f; subsequently won over today's trip on Dundalk AW; possible that he will step up on the form of last month's outings at the Curragh and Cork.

races.paceDynamic: Thru And Thru will lead uncontested with no other confirmed front-runners in the field. The prominent runners Bella Isabella, Flaming Rib, Playin Cool, Great Mover and Send Harry will likely sit just off the pace, creating a moderate gallop rather than true pressure. With multiple hold-up horses including Mallavelly, Dark Viper, Mehman, Eddie G and Loingseoir needing to be delivered late, the lack of early pace pressure strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and kick clear before the closers get organized.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Thru And Thru gets soft fractions and stays strong
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time in front with no pace pressure, allowing her to save energy for a sustained kick. The hold-up horses face too much ground to make up over 7f on good-to-soft going.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners apply pressure from 3f out
scenarios.body: Bella Isabella, Flaming Rib or Playin Cool track the leader closely and exploit their superior tactical position when Thru And Thru weakens. The multiple hold-up horses get caught wide and deep with insufficient time to close.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle stages
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure creates a crawling gallop that turns into a sprint finish. Mallavelly or Dark Viper benefit from their superior class and finishing kick over the shorter effective distance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Muddle
scenarios.trigger: If Thru And Thru goes too slowly and gets swamped
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no clear pace dynamics, allowing an outsider to benefit from the tactical confusion. Multiple horses converge in a blanket finish with the best-handicapped prevailing.

watchPoints.text: Thru And Thru's fitness after 50-day break could see her fold quickly if the prominent runners apply any pressure
Mallavelly's ability to get a clear run from his hold-up style with multiple horses likely to be in similar positions
Bella Isabella's early positioning as the most likely to benefit if tracking the leader closely
The effectiveness of Flaming Rib after 169 days off from a stable struggling for winners
Dark Viper's adaptability to the sharper 7f trip when his best efforts come over longer distances

races.name: King George V Cup (Listed Race)

runners_data.name: Endorsement
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with superior official rating who should appreciate the longer trip but faces 25 days since last outing
runners_data.comment: Boasts form linked to several key Derby contenders, can make the most of this opportunity
runners_data.spotlight: Second to the current Derby favourite Benvenuto Cellini on debut at Killarney; best display at two when second to Pierre Bonnard in the Zetland Stakes; this year's course form involves links to Derby candidates; stuck to his task to take second when Pierre Bonnard flopped in the Ballysax; pick of these on his close third behind James J Braddock and Pierre Bonnard in the Derby Trial.

runners_data.name: Amadeus Mozart
runners_data.note: Fellow prominent runner from same stable with fresher preparation but lower class level than main rival
runners_data.comment: Trip should be within his range but stablemate Endorsement has a stronger profile
runners_data.spotlight: Made a winning debut in a 7f maiden at the Curragh last June; no match for Godolphin's Maho Bay in a novice event at Newmarket in April (winner a beaten favourite in the Lingfield Derby Trial on next start); looked in need of further when failing to make an impact in the 1m2f Gallinule Stakes won by stablemate Causeway.

runners_data.name: Emmeleia
runners_data.comment: Non-runner
runners_data.spotlight: Non-runner

runners_data.name: So Must I
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer whose handicap form suggests insufficient quality for this Listed company despite staying credentials
runners_data.comment: AW winner,  form in turf handicaps does not inspire confidence at this level.
runners_data.spotlight: Winner of a middle-distance Dundalk conditions race in February; subsequent form in turf handicaps does not inspire confidence at this level.

runners_data.name: Yousaynothingatall
runners_data.note: Rear-runner whose maiden victory came over similar distance but faces significant class rise from handicap level
runners_data.comment: 80-rated maiden winner, same handicap mark as So Must I but likely more progressive
runners_data.spotlight: Handicap mark unchanged on 80 after a maiden win at Cork a month on her fifth start; safely held by Emmeleia on running at Dundalk in April.

races.paceDynamic: With Emmeleia declared a non-runner, this small field loses its natural pace-setter, leaving prominent racers Endorsement and Amadeus Mozart to dictate from the front. The early gallop will likely be modest with both horses content to track each other through steady fractions over the extended 1m4f trip. Hold-up horses So Must I and Yousaynothingatall will settle at the rear but face the challenge of making up significant ground in the straight. This measured pace scenario clearly favours the prominent runners who can control proceedings and kick clear when the real racing begins.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Endorsement or Amadeus Mozart establish an uncontested lead through steady fractions
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets an easy time of it before quickening approaching the straight, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up the leeway from the rear. Superior class tells when the leaders can dictate their own kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Dual Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Endorsement and Amadeus Mozart engage in a prolonged speed duel from the home turn
scenarios.body: Both prominent runners compromise each other's finishing kick, opening the door for the hold-up pair to close strongly. The stronger stayer among the closers capitalizes on the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Separation
scenarios.trigger: If the superior-rated Endorsement can settle and quicken decisively in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: Ryan Moore's mount uses his higher official rating to outclass these rivals when the pace lifts, despite any tactical compromises. The Ballydoyle second-string cannot match the acceleration.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test
scenarios.trigger: If the extended trip and yielding ground creates a genuine staying test
scenarios.body: The race becomes a slog that favours horses with proven middle-distance form over 1m4f+. Previous winners at this distance hold the edge over those stepping up significantly.

watchPoints.text: Monitor if Endorsement shows any rustiness early given the 25-day gap since his last appearance
Watch for Amadeus Mozart to steal a march if he can get first run on his stablemate Endorsement
Observe whether So Must I or Yousaynothingatall can get competitive positions given their hold-up styles
Check early pace development with Emmeleia withdrawn as the confirmed front-runner

races.name: BOYLE Sports 'Home Of The Early Payout' Handicap

runners_data.name: Son Of Beauty
runners_data.note: Hold-up type switching from AW to turf with 38-day break, needs strong pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: Needs to improve on opening two handicap runs, longer trip may help
runners_data.spotlight: AW maiden winner over 1m in early March and just fair efforts since in Naas handicaps, beaten around 5l in Madrid Handicap (7f) and stayed on late over 1m when beaten under 4l in premier handicap in late April; up another furlong in trip here and needs to improve for it.

runners_data.name: Sunrush
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with decent recent form, trainer Andrew Slattery having moderate 14-day strike rate
runners_data.comment: Yard in fine form but may need more time to make an impact in handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Last month's seasonal return here (1m) was okay but nothing to suggest he'll make an immediate impact in handicaps off this mark, albeit has to be respected from a yard having a great season.

runners_data.name: How'sthebai

runners_data.name: Red Autumn
runners_data.note: Sole front runner returning from 74-day break, Chris Hayes aboard for in-form Weld yard
runners_data.comment: Naas comeback run over inadequate trip encouraging; longer trip to suit, should go well
runners_data.spotlight: Won Bellewstown maiden last year and decent second in Roscommon winners' contest, best efforts; encouraging comeback run in Madrid Handicap at Naas in late March, staying on late into fourth over inadequate 7f; step up in trip seems sure to suit and top-weight should go well.

runners_data.name: Ryefield Dasher
runners_data.note: Prominent style but massive 214-day layoff is major concern, claimed apprentice Nicola Burns takes 5lbs off
runners_data.comment: Likely more to offer this year but lack of a recent run a concern on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Cheaply bought Time Test colt showed fair form in three outings late last season, latter two in good-class Curragh maidens when intimating a step up in trip would suit; lack of a recent run a concern here on seasonal return and handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Johnny Soda
runners_data.note: Prominent tracker with recent soft ground win, suits this intermediate trip better than longer distances

runners_data.spotlight: Breakthrough win at Cork (1m, soft) last month when coming late (beating a subsequent winner); didn't appear to stay 1m2f at Navan 13 days later, this intermediate trip could suit.

runners_data.name: Monvoe

runners_data.comment: Hat-trick seeker up 16lb but remains a big player with rider's claim a positive

runners_data.name: Sweet Baby Zou
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with first-time cheekpieces after recent quick turnaround, tendency to fade late is concerning
runners_data.comment: Much improved for Gowran win on Monday; 7lb penalty but likely the one to beat
runners_data.spotlight: Step up in trip and first-time cheekpieces brought improvement when getting off the mark over slightly further at Gowran on Monday (two days after being well held at Down Royal) on easier ground, winning comfortably having hit the front some way out (first two clear); quick return under mandatory 7lb penalty and could be hard to beat on similar ground.

races.paceDynamic: Red Autumn stands alone as the only confirmed front runner in this 8-runner handicap, meaning he can dictate an uncontested lead and control the fractions throughout. With prominent runners Sunrush, Johnny Soda and Ryefield Dasher likely to track him at a respectful distance, the pace should be sustainable rather than cut-throat. The majority of the field comprises hold-up horses (Son Of Beauty, How'sthebai, Monvoe, Sweet Baby Zou) who will need the pace to collapse or rely on a strong finish. This race shape clearly favors horses with tactical speed who can position prominently and avoid traffic, as the soft ground will make it difficult for hold-up horses to make up significant ground in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Red Autumn gets an easy lead and sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: Red Autumn can use his class advantage and fresh legs to hold off challengers, while prominent trackers like Johnny Soda benefit from the tow. The hold-up brigade struggle on yielding ground to make up the leeway.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely steady and the field compacts
scenarios.body: The yielding ground plays to stamina types like Monvoe and How'sthebai who can use their recent form momentum. Sweet Baby Zou's cheekpieces and trip increase also come into play despite her finishing concerns.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Red Autumn goes too fast early or ties up late
scenarios.body: Sunrush and Johnny Soda get perfect trips tracking the leader and have enough pace to strike when the front runner weakens. The ground conditions favor Johnny Soda's recent soft ground form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Red Autumn goes very slow and kicks hard late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse can win from any position. Ryefield Dasher's long absence becomes less relevant and Sweet Baby Zou's finishing issues are minimized.

watchPoints.text: Red Autumn's fitness after 74-day break - any sign of laboring late could open the door for closers
How'sthebai's early position with Colin Keane - if he gets handy early it signals confidence in his stamina
Johnny Soda's tactical approach - needs to track the pace closely to use his recent momentum
Sweet Baby Zou settling in cheekpieces on quick turnaround - first-time headgear can be transformative
Monvoe's finishing kick from the rear - his recent late surges suggest he has the engine for another bold show

races.name: BOYLE Sports Best Odds From 8am Handicap

runners_data.name: Booyea

races.paceDynamic: Diamond Exchange and Walhaan are confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, with Coul Dreamer, Harana and Sonoran likely to press them from prominent positions. This honest gallop over 1m1f at Leopardstown will stretch the field and create a true test of stamina. The strong pace will set up perfectly for hold-up horses with tactical speed to finish strongly in the final two furlongs. This race shape clearly favours hold-up performers who can capitalize on the expected collapse of the early pace-setters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If Diamond Exchange and Walhaan duel early and Coul Dreamer/Sonoran press them hard
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will tire the leaders and prominent racers, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep past in the final furlong with superior finishing kicks. Booyea, Molto Amichi and No More Porter can exploit the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers gets an easier lead than expected with Walhaan struggling
scenarios.body: Sonoran or Harana could survive the pace if they secure ideal positions just behind a modest gallop and have enough left to hold off late challengers. Their class advantage over pure hold-up horses becomes decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Diamond Exchange gets an uncontested lead with Walhaan pulled up early
scenarios.body: The Jessica Harrington filly could dictate terms and prove too classy for this field, using her recent C&D form advantage. Her progressive profile suggests she can handle the pressure of leading throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both main pace-setters are pulled up or fade dramatically early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish from the back with the most talented hold-up horse winning. Elusive Duke's long absence becomes less relevant in a slowly-run affair.

watchPoints.text: Diamond Exchange could get uncontested lead if Walhaan struggles early, making her very dangerous
Booyea's reapplication of cheekpieces combined with strong early pace creates winning conditions for him
Molto Amichi needed his comeback run and this drop in grade suits his hold-up style perfectly
Walhaan's recent hurdle form suggests stamina concerns that could see him fade or be pulled up
Majestic King faces quick turnaround after impressive Gowran win just three days ago

races.paceDynamic: Two And Two is the sole confirmed front-runner and will set his own agenda from the gates, likely joined by prominent racers Glamazon, Almeiyda, Nicky Larson and Down The Glen in the early positions. With 12 of the 17 runners holding up or racing in midfield, there's significant pressure building behind what should be a moderate early pace. The yielding ground will make it harder for the large hold-up contingent to make up ground in the straight, creating a traffic jam scenario. This pace shape strongly favours prominent racers and those who can get early position, as the sheer volume of hold-up horses will struggle to find racing room when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace allows prominent runners to conserve energy while hold-up horses get caught behind traffic.
scenarios.body: Two And Two sustains his lead while Glamazon, Almeiyda and Nicky Larson finish strongly having avoided the scramble behind. The yielding ground aids stamina over speed, suiting those who race handily.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Jam
scenarios.trigger: If the large pack of hold-up horses creates a wall of traffic in the straight as they all look for gaps simultaneously.
scenarios.body: Chirac and Cosmic Funk get clear runs but most hold-up runners are trapped behind faltering leaders. The prominent racers maintain their advantage as the chasers can't get into contention.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the hold-up brigade gets a perfect passage through.
scenarios.body: Balance Of Trade and Wicklow Gap benefit from their recent strong-finishing efforts, while the early leaders fade on the testing ground. Clean runs allow the closers to demonstrate their stamina.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Upset
scenarios.trigger: If Two And Two goes too fast early and prominent runners also commit too soon.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a staying test where lightly-weighted hold-up horses with stamina prove best. This scenario requires significant pace pressure that seems unlikely given the setup.

watchPoints.text: Two And Two could get an uncontested lead with no other confirmed front-runners, making him very hard to peg back
Traffic problems in straight as 12 hold-up/midfield runners all converge at once looking for racing room
Balance Of Trade showed improved form when getting clear run on Monday after slow start, similar scenario possible
Wide draws affecting De Songbird, Jp's Express and Wicklow Gap in large field where early position crucial
First-time equipment changes on Love Orchid (cheekpieces) and Cameclose (cheekpieces for blinkers) worth monitoring
